mapper.select: SELECT c.calc_id, c.emp_id, c.calc_month, c.basic_salary, c.post_allowance, c.overtime_salary, c.leave_deduct, c.absent_deduct, c.total_income, c.social_security, c.provident_fund, c.personal_tax, c.net_salary, c.calc_status, c.create_time, c.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_code, '') AS emp_code, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS emp_name FROM hr_sal_calculate c LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON c.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE c.calc_id = #{calcId}

SELECT c.calc_id, c.emp_id, c.calc_month, c.basic_salary, c.post_allowance, c.overtime_salary, c.leave_deduct, c.absent_deduct, c.total_income, c.social_security, c.provident_fund, c.personal_tax, c.net_salary, c.calc_status, c.create_time, c.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_code, '') AS emp_code, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS emp_name FROM hr_sal_calculate c LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON c.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE c.emp_id = #{empId} AND c.calc_month = #{calcMonth}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_sal_calculate (emp_id, calc_month, basic_salary, post_allowance, overtime_salary, leave_deduct, absent_deduct, total_income, social_security, provident_fund, personal_tax, net_salary, calc_status) VALUES (#{empId}, #{calcMonth}, #{basicSalary}, #{postAllowance}, #{overtimeSalary}, #{leaveDeduct}, #{absentDeduct}, #{totalIncome}, #{socialSecurity}, #{providentFund}, #{personalTax}, #{netSalary}, #{calcStatus})
